newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Bicycle '96 net hits 30 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Bicycle '96 net hits 30 mln yuan.

text.p: China Bicycle Company (Holdings) Ltd registered net profits of 30.18 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.06 yuan in 1996, while turnover reached 1.03 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 51.25 million yuan based on Chinese standards. No net profit figure compiled under international standards was given in the firm's 1995 annual report.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoOn, it said.
